title: Crash debris and government pen at Archuleta Mesa

tellings.quote: Gabe said they went up there and found, you know, broken up brush and evidence that something had been picked up and a pen that said US government property on it.

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, passes on what a local lawman, Gabe Valdez, told him about Archuleta Mesa, a high plateau in New Mexico, in the early 1980s. Valdez said they went up there and found broken brush, signs that something had been picked up and taken away, and a pen marked "US government property." If true, it would suggest the government quietly recovered something from the site.
